title: 4-Hour Okanagan Valley Wine Tasting. Wineries of East Kelowna Bench.
includes: Use of coolers for wine purchases
No drinking is allowed in the transport vehicle (not included)
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Wear comfortable shoes for walking through a variety of terrains and conditions
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Moments from Kelowna's urban centre you will find yourself amongst vineyard and orchard, drinking in the amazing views - along with some great wine! A perfectly relaxing way to spend an afternoon exploring the diverse wineries offered in this area.
